summary: First backend smoke pass for Kanak Infosys. Registered two clients (u2 referred by u1), exercised auth, profile, deposits (min-lock enforcement + 6-month lock), earnings summary/daily, referrals tree, and all admin endpoints (including xlsx export). 35/36 checks passed. Only failure: GET /api/ returns 404 due to route being declared after app.include_router(api).
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates client with KNK-prefixed referral_code and JWT
Register with valid referral sets referred_by_code; invalid referral -> 400
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns current user
POST /api/deposits below 1L -> 400; 1L succeeds; lock_until ~180 days out
GET /api/referrals/my returns tree with referred child
All /api/admin/* endpoints return 403 for client role
admin stats total_revenue reflects deposits, total_clients matches count
admin/referral-tree returns forest (array) with children arrays

failed.issue: Returns 404 Not Found instead of {service:'kanak-infosys', status:'ok'}
failed.evidence: Response body: {"detail":"Not Found"}. In /app/backend/server.py the @api.get('/') route is defined on line 519, AFTER app.include_router(api) on line 464, so the route is never registered on the FastAPI app.

action_items: Move the @api.get('/') health route definition ABOVE app.include_router(api) (or add app.include_router(api) again after it). Simplest fix: move the root() handler up near the other @api routes.
